DocsLab.dc.html.title: Docs lab · one Docs, several sources, one knowledge base: the architecture of a worked example, the corporate credit platform (microservices for the Request, Client and Facility teams), drawn with the AIToolbox ArchiMate notation and read as LikeC4 views, in three areas: Catalogue (133 building blocks on a rich baseline: Credit origination monolith with its modules, Oracle schema, MQ, Control-M and file interfaces by layer, element page with relationships, plateaus, detailed design, decisions, review and LikeC4 source), Views (13 LikeC4 views by TOGAF ADM phase that drill down with crumbs and back: value stream › stage › business process, application cooperation › inside the monolith or inside a hexagonal service › the detailed design of each element: domain, events, ports, use cases, adapters, API, state machine, data model; on each plateau and as gaps between two plateaus) and Process (each change through decide · design · review · deliver, with ADR, ARB and the roadmap; an ARB in review with 12 checks, 4 reviewers and their notes, conditions, what is asked of the board, and an ASD showing the 13 items it must cover, written sections and sections generated from the model), the AI wiki (tips, procedures and news written by the community), operations (release train, Request · Client · Facility teams and on-call, incidents, design system), the new joiner path, and Administration › Core › Knowledge base · search and questions only from the header, going back with a subheader · way in A · Spaces adopted (B Application lens and C Ask first kept for the record) · press Play

ProcessLab.dc.html.title: Process lab · four shapes for the Process area, same data: A By object (adopted 2026-11-03: Changes, Reviews, Decisions, Model checks, How it works) · B Board (the changes by step, Decide · Design · Review · Deliver · Delivered, tinted when a step needs attention; decisions, checks and the guide as chips) · C Agenda and roadmap (ARB sessions with their submissions and readiness, the enterprise roadmap, conditions and asks by due date) · D Inbox (what needs the person viewing: owner, reviewer, chair, reader; then everything else) · view as change owner, reviewer, board chair or reader · press Play

StartLab.dc.html.title: Change start lab (decided 2026-11-10: start = C signals + B assistant, follow = B tracks, intake and changes in two places) · two decisions on the Process, same example data (19 changes on every phase of the adjusted TOGAF flow and at every gate G1–G4: waiting, in review, changes requested, rejected, passed, passed with conditions; each with where it comes from: business request, conversation, exploration, technology standard, decision, code first, model finding, incident) · START a change: A a form in three questions (origin, kind, scope → entry phase, documents, next gate computed) · B in the assistant (say what happened, the assistant proposes origin, entry, class, scope and overlaps) · C from the signal (Incoming: tickets, pull requests, radar, findings, ADRs, incidents → open as a change, attach, dismiss) · FOLLOW the phases: A board by phase · B tracks (one row per change: skipped, done, current, gates) · C by gate (waiting, sent back, passed, who decides) · D ADM phases (TOGAF A to H, what each produces, its gate, its changes) · click a change for its origin, phases, documents and gate · press Play
